core: Soluble inositol polyphosphate and pyrophosphate metabolism
qualifier: with inositol transport
name: Soluble inositol polyphosphate and pyrophosphate metabolism, inositol transport
rationale: All members concern synthesis, turnover or uptake of soluble inositol phosphates/pyrophosphates (with NUDT-type diadenosine polyphosphate hydrolysis), and the inositol transport and ER-lumen IP synthesis set it apart from the nucleotide-interconversion and PIP/PTEN neighbours.

qualifier: prostate gland epithelium and branching
name: Prostate gland and male genitalia development
rationale: Members cover prostate budding, branching, acinus formation, epithelial differentiation and male genital morphogenesis, distinguishing the theme from female reproductive tract, gonad, mammary and salivary gland neighbours.

qualifier: eicosanoid and S1P receptors via G-beta-gamma effectors
name: Eicosanoid and sphingosine-1-phosphate GPCR signaling via G-beta-gamma
rationale: Members are leukotriene, prostanoid and S1P receptor signaling plus G-beta-gamma coupling to PI3K-gamma and PLC-beta, whereas neighbours concern leukotriene synthesis, histamine receptors or generic PLC calcium signaling.

core: RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription and ribosome biogenesis
qualifier: MYC- and nutrient-controlled
name: MYC- and nutrient-controlled ribosome biogenesis via RNA polymerase I
rationale: All members concern regulation of Pol I rRNA synthesis and ribosome biogenesis, and the MYC target sets, SIRT1 repression and methionine response separate it from the general Pol I/II/III machinery and rRNA-processing neighbours.

core: Pre-mRNA splicing and nuclear RNA processing
qualifier: with nuclear exosome RNA decay and surveillance
name: Spliceosomal pre-mRNA splicing and nuclear exosome RNA decay
rationale: Members combine spliceosome assembly and splice-site recognition with exosome-mediated 3'-to-5' nuclear RNA decay and surveillance, which the export, 3'-end processing and snRNA-transcription neighbours lack.

qualifier: chambers, septa, valves and endocardial cushion EMT
name: Heart chamber, septum and valve morphogenesis with endocardial cushion EMT
rationale: Members span ventricular/atrial myocardium, septation, valve formation, endocardial cushion EMT and second heart field, distinguishing the theme from outflow tract/neural crest, coronary vascular, sarcomere and conduction-system neighbours.

qualifier: semaphorin, ephrin, netrin and Slit-Robo cues
name: Axon guidance by semaphorin, ephrin, netrin and Slit-Robo cues
rationale: Members are axon guidance, growth-cone repulsion/attraction, sprouting and neuronal adhesion driven by the canonical guidance cue families, which the neighbours represent only partially and without the netrin/Slit/ephrin arms.

core: Regulation of synapse organization and transmission
qualifier: postsynaptic organization and neuron maturation
name: Pre- and postsynaptic organization regulating neuron maturation and transmission
rationale: Members regulate presynaptic and postsynaptic structure, neurotransmitter release/uptake, LTP and neuronal maturation, and the postsynaptic organization and maturation terms separate it from the vesicle-recycling and receptor-trafficking neighbours.

qualifier: in testis Sertoli cell development
name: Activin, AMH and FSH signaling in Sertoli cell development
rationale: Members combine activin/follistatin, AMH and FSH/LH glycoprotein hormone signaling with Sertoli cell proliferation and seminiferous tubule development, whereas neighbours concern ovarian follicle, LH and GnRH responses.

qualifier: positive and negative regulation of chemotaxis and extravasation
name: Regulation of neutrophil chemotaxis and transendothelial extravasation
rationale: All members regulate granulocyte/neutrophil chemotaxis, migration or diapedesis in both directions, distinguishing the theme from formyl peptide receptor, inflammatory and integrin/T-cell extravasation neighbours.

core: Regulation of miRNA and mRNA decay
qualifier: miRNA turnover and deadenylation-dependent target decay
name: Regulation of miRNA turnover and deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay
rationale: Members regulate miRNA degradation and pre-miRNA processing together with miRNA-directed deadenylation, poly(A) shortening and P-body assembly, whereas neighbours concern miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and translational repression.

qualifier: progenitor lineages to endocrine, exocrine and ductal cells
name: Pancreatic progenitor differentiation into endocrine, exocrine and ductal lineages
rationale: Members trace multipotent pancreatic progenitors through NEUROG3+ endocrine, alpha-cell, exocrine and ductal lineages with neuroendocrine and HNF-driven epithelial maturation, distinguishing them from definitive endoderm, intestinal epithelium, beta-cell insulin secretion and gonadal neighbours.

qualifier: with visual phototransduction and retinoic acid signaling
name: Retinoid metabolism, retinoic acid signaling and visual phototransduction
rationale: Members cover the visual retinoid cycle, opsin phototransduction and its inherited defects, retinoic acid synthesis/catabolism and response, which separate the theme from eye-morphogenesis and vitamin D/K metabolism neighbours.

qualifier: Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switching and securin/cyclin B degradation
name: APC/C regulation and Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switching at anaphase
rationale: All members concern APC/C activity control in mitosis (phosphorylation, inhibition, Cdc20-driven securin/cyclin B destruction, switch to Cdh1 and Cdh1 autodegradation), distinguishing it from neighbours focused on Nek2A/cyclin A targets or generic mitotic exit.

core: Telomere protection and DNA structure remodeling
qualifier: R-loops, fork reversal and NHEJ suppression
name: Telomere protection and DNA topology remodeling during replication and repair
rationale: Members combine telomere capping, recombination-based telomere maintenance and NHEJ protection with R-loop processing, fork reversal and DNA topological change, unlike neighbours centred on telomeric C-strand synthesis, replication-stress checkpoints or break-induced replication.

qualifier: T cell immunological synapse
name: Integrin-mediated T cell adhesion and immunological synapse formation
rationale: Members concern integrin activation, heterotypic leukocyte adhesion and T cell polarity, raft localization and synapse formation, distinguishing the theme from CD28-Vav1/Rho neighbours and the neutrophil diapedesis neighbour.

qualifier: store-operated entry and ER-mitochondria calcium transfer
name: Store-operated calcium entry and ER-mitochondria calcium transfer
rationale: Members concern calcium sensing, store-operated entry, ER calcium depletion and mitochondrial calcium uptake at ER-mitochondria contacts, which the ryanodine/caffeine and voltage-gated release neighbours lack.

qualifier: naive and memory B cells
name: Naive and memory B cell transcriptional signatures
rationale: Members are naive, memory and generic B cell expression signatures with adaptive memory response, distinguishing them from germinal centre, Tfh, plasma cell and B cell activation neighbours.

qualifier: with congenital glycosylation disorders
name: Nucleotide-sugar transport into Golgi and congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members are SLC35/SLC33A1 luminal substrate transporters, their CDG and related disease variants and UDP-glucuronate formation, whereas neighbours concern sugar-donor biosynthesis, N-glycan processing, glycosphingolipid or GPI synthesis.

qualifier: membrane potential and sarcoplasmic calcium release
name: Cardiomyocyte membrane potential and sarcoplasmic calcium release
rationale: The three members concern ion homeostasis setting cardiac membrane potential and calcium-release-driven contraction, distinguishing the theme from conduction, inotropy/heart rate, NCX and SA-node pacemaker neighbours.

qualifier: cardiac mesoderm, second heart field and coronary vessels
name: Cardiac mesoderm, second heart field and coronary vessel development
rationale: Members cover mesodermal fate, second heart field, heart tube and pericardium morphogenesis with cardiac vascular smooth muscle and coronary vasculogenesis, unlike neighbours focused on chambers, septa, valves, conduction or outflow tract.

qualifier: proliferation, migration and fusion
name: Myoblast proliferation, migration and fusion in muscle regeneration
rationale: All three members promote myoblast proliferation, migration or regenerative fusion, distinguishing the theme from neighbours on negative regulation of myogenesis, satellite cell maintenance or myoblast differentiation.

qualifier: glycosylase excision, alkylation reversal and TET-TDG demethylation
name: Base excision repair, alkylation reversal and TET-TDG DNA demethylation
rationale: Members cover DNA glycosylase recognition and BER gap filling with their disease defects, ALKBH/MGMT direct reversal, NEIL3/Fanconi crosslink resolution and TET-TDG demethylation, unlike the APOBEC/ADAR editing, mismatch repair and translesion synthesis neighbours.

core: Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization in apoptosis
qualifier: positive and negative regulation
name: Bidirectional regulation of mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization in apoptosis
rationale: All three members regulate MOMP and cytochrome c release in both directions, whereas neighbours describe oxidative-stress apoptosis, BH3-only activation, BAX/BAK oligomerization or apoptosome events.

qualifier: amino acids, peptides and urate with aminoacidurias
name: Epithelial amino acid, peptide and urate transport and aminoacidurias
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane carriers for amino acids, oligopeptides, polyamines, organic cations and urate, with renal aminoaciduria and hypouricemia defects, distinguishing them from hexose, monocarboxylate and TCA-intermediate transport neighbours.
